_comment: Basic support for the car agent in languages the model was NOT tuned for (2026-11-21). English and pt-BR are the tuned languages and never use this file. In a Basic language every car action is first asked ('q' around a template) and runs only after a yes; lookups answer directly. Shared by the RN and Flutter car demos (copy, keep identical). 'pack' overrides the English agent pack's spoken prompts; 'messages' are the app's own sentences.

_hints: 'hints' (2026-11-21): English words the app adds in brackets to what the user said, e.g. 'Mach die Musik leiser (music, volume down)': the model only knows English and Portuguese, and with them it picks the right car action far more often (9 languages, 108 fresh sentences: 49% -> 78% right; 86% after adding the words that test showed were missing). Patterns match the user's words folded: lower case, accents removed (ß, ø, æ stay), anything else between words is one space.
